description: HBERT is an open-source Revit plugin that measures embodied carbon of materials assigned within a building model. The Hawkins Brown repository README identifies its purpose and links the project's wiki for use details. Users open a Revit model with material quantities and corresponding carbon factors; outputs are component or building embodied-impact estimates, depending on the model setup. Geographic coverage follows the building designed, while factors may be region-specific. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the plugin. A limitation is that Revit quantities and material mappings may omit construction waste, replacements or locally sourced product differences; the plugin does not by itself validate a full life-cycle assessment. HBERT can prepare material-impact inputs for building retrofit or infrastructure-stock scenarios. The related Brightway catalogue platform can run broader life-cycle calculations. No BIM model, factor database or plugin installer was downloaded.
name: HBERT Revit embodied-carbon plugin
